title: Halting detection by a fixed particle under initialized periodic solenoidal forcing
exact_target: For each fixed positive computable viscosity, can every deterministic one-tape machine and finite input be effectively encoded into smooth divergence-free mean-zero forcing on $T^3$, with a unique zero-data global classical Navier–Stokes solution, all mixed force and velocity derivatives globally bounded and uniform kinetic energy, such that both fields are one-periodic after initialization and the particle from one fixed label enters one fixed open strip exactly if the machine halts? Require the repeated mechanism for a fixed machine to be independent of its input.
